title: EVP Assets - Miner
description: Optional assets for Miner villager profession
body:
Optional assets for [EVP - Miner](https://modrinth.com/datapack/evp-miner).

Includes texture and lang files.

<details>
<summary>Supported languages:</summary>

- \*all english variations\* _(implied, fallback)_
- ar_sa (Arabic)
- de_de (German)
- es_es (Spanish)
- fr_fr (French)
- it_it (Italian)
- ja_jp (Japanese)
- ko_kr (Korean)
- ru_ru (Russian)
- zh_cn (Chinese)

</details>

**Requires [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures). Otherwise textures wont work!**

![Minecraft villager with a leather apron and a mining cap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76b891905551d38195f510d19fd25decebf2c277.png)

_The cap's bulb glows in the dark!_
